basics.name: Jakob Gabriel
basics.label: Digital Business Value Engineer
basics.summary: Digital transformation and advanced analytics expert with a proven record in scaling smart-factory solutions, optimizing manufacturing processes, and delivering measurable business value. Passionate about enabling innovation, driving agile projects, and empowering teams through data-driven culture and capability building.

work.name: ContiTech Techno-Chemie GmbH
work.summary: Driving digital transformation and analytics strategy across global manufacturing sites, with a focus on measurable value creation and scalability.
highlights: Scaled over 50 digitalization use cases globally, achieving more than €1M in annual cost savings by applying analytics-driven optimization.
Developed energy and process efficiency analytics workflows that became reference models for data-driven manufacturing.
Championed more than 15 innovation projects annually, guiding proof-of-concepts into fully operational digital products.
Built organizational capabilities through 20+ training programs, expanding the Smart Factory network to 100+ active members worldwide.
Redesigned three major core processes to reduce lead times by more than 10%, leveraging advanced analytics insights.

work.name: ContiTech Techno-Chemie GmbH
work.summary: Designed and implemented analytics-driven solutions for manufacturing challenges while enabling global scalability across production sites.
highlights: Transformed raw production data into actionable insights, uncovering hidden inefficiencies and improving overall equipment effectiveness.
Orchestrated cross-functional teams to develop predictive analytics models that prevented production bottlenecks and reduced waste.
Defined global digitalization standards that unified data quality, analytics methodologies, and reporting across plants.
Built intuitive dashboards that empowered operators and engineers to make faster, evidence-based decisions.
Created knowledge-sharing platforms and internal documentation that accelerated learning and scaled analytics adoption enterprise-wide.
Secured budget approvals and ensured long-term alignment between analytics projects and strategic business objectives.

work.name: ContiTech MGW GmbH
work.summary: Ensured product quality during ramp up through risk management, process optimization, and customer-focused quality control and improvement initiatives.
highlights: Championed continuous improvement by identifying and eliminating root causes of quality issues, leading to a significant reduction in defect rates.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to strengthen FMEA practices, transforming risk assessments into actionable process improvements.
Designed and implemented inspection concepts for precision blow-molded components, enhancing product reliability and traceability.
Built trusted relationships with customers through transparent communication, acceptance tests, and successful audit results.
Introduced quality dashboards that visualized real-time KPIs, improving decision-making speed on the shop floor.

education.summary: Advanced academic foundation in polymer engineering with a strong focus on industrial applications, process optimization, and manufacturing.
highlights: **Master Thesis:** 'Process Mining in Manufacturing – A Case Study on Data-Driven Potential Analysis.'
**Project:** Developed a predictive model for weld strength using infrared imaging and process data analytics.

education.summary: Dual degree combining academic theory with hands-on industrial insights in polymer engineering and automated production systems.
highlights: **Bachelor Thesis:** 'Automation of Testing and Packaging Using Robotics and Vision Systems in an Assembly Line.'
